def fn(x):
    # QWERTY keyboard substitution
    plain  = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    cipher = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"
    trans = {p: c for p, c in zip(plain, cipher)}

    res = []
    for ch in x:
        if ch.isalpha():
            lower = ch.lower()
            mapped = trans[lower]
            res.append(mapped.upper() if ch.isupper() else mapped)
        else:
            res.append(ch)
    return "".join(res)
```

def fn(x):
    # QWERTY keyboard substitution
    plain  = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    cipher = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"
    trans = {p: c for p, c in zip(plain, cipher)}

    res = []
    for ch in x:
        if ch.isalpha():
            lower = ch.lower()
            mapped = trans[lower]
            res.append(mapped.upper() if ch.isupper() else mapped)
        else:
            res.append(ch)
    return "".join(res)
